list.title: Users
list.description: Manage accounts, status and role assignments.
list.searchPlaceholder: Search email, username or display name

create.title: Create user
create.description: An activation link is sent; the user sets their own password.
create.activationHint: Admins never set passwords: activation email only.

delete.title: Delete user
delete.confirm: Delete "{{name}}"? The account is signed out immediately and moved to the trash, where it can be restored until the retention period ends.
delete.selfProtected: You cannot delete your own account.

assignRole.stale: Someone else just changed this user's roles; your selection is based on outdated data.

resetPassword.title: Reset password
resetPassword.confirm: A password reset link will be sent to {{email}} and recorded in the audit log. Send it?

delete.title: Delete users
delete.confirm_one: Delete {{count}} user? The account will be soft-deleted and signed out immediately.
delete.confirm_other: Delete {{count}} users? Their accounts will be soft-deleted and signed out immediately.
delete.ineligible: You cannot delete your own account.

unlock.title: Unlock users
unlock.ineligible: Only locked users can be unlocked.

deactivate.title: Deactivate users
deactivate.confirm_one: Deactivate {{count}} user? They will be signed out immediately.
deactivate.confirm_other: Deactivate {{count}} users? They will be signed out immediately.
deactivate.ineligible: The selected users are already deactivated, or it is your own account.

activate.title: Activate users
activate.ineligible: Only deactivated users can be activated, and you cannot change your own account.

detail.title: User detail
detail.selfHint: You cannot change your own status or roles; ask another administrator.
detail.lockedHint: This account is locked after too many failed sign-ins. Editing does not change that; use Unlock to restore sign-in.
detail.groupsHint: Roles held by these groups also apply to this user, including parent groups of nested groups.
detail.effectiveHint: Where each permission comes from: through which groups and which role. Groups or roles you cannot see show only their kind.
detail.apiTokensHint: Tokens this user created to call the external API as themselves. Revoke them here when their role changes or a token leaks.

deactivate.title: Deactivate user
deactivate.confirm: Deactivate "{{name}}"? They will be signed out immediately.

orgUnit.searchPlaceholder: Search by department name or code

identities.title: External identities
identities.hint: Identities from external IdPs (OIDC, SAML) linked to this account. Unlink one that belongs to someone else or that the person no longer uses; signing in with it later matches an account by email again.
identities.subject: External identifier
identities.unlinkConfirm: Unlink "{{provider}}"? Signing in with it later matches an account again; an SSO-only account without a password may be unable to sign in.
